name: CurrencyInput
label: Currency input
description: An amount of money as a decimal string, read in the locale's marks and grouped once the field is left.

props.name: value
props.description: The amount as a decimal string (`"1234.50"`), or `null` for none (controlled). Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The amount the field starts with (uncontrolled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the amount as a normalised decimal string as the reader types, or `null` while the field holds no number. Fires alongside the native `onChange`.

props.name: currency
props.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency, such as `USD`, `EUR` or `JPY`. Defaults to `USD`.

props.name: currencyDisplay
props.description: How the currency shows inside the field: its symbol, its code, or nothing (when the label already says it). The side it sits on follows the locale.

props.name: fractionDigits
props.description: Digits after the point. Defaults to the currency's own: 0 for JPY, 2 for USD, 3 for KWD.

props.name: allowNegative
props.description: Accept a negative amount (a refund, an adjustment). Defaults to false.

props.name: min
props.description: The smallest amount, as a decimal string. A value below it is raised to it when the field loses focus.

props.name: max
props.description: The largest amount, as a decimal string. A value above it is lowered to it when the field loses focus.

props.name: step
props.description: How much the Up and Down arrow keys add or take away, as a decimal string. Defaults to `"1"`.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the amount is read and written in, such as `de-DE`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: size
props.description: Component size (not the native character-width `size` attribute).

props.name: errorText
props.description: The error message under the field; setting it marks the field invalid.

props.name: error
props.description: Error state without a message of its own.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name. The form receives the normalised decimal string through a hidden input, never the formatted text.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes, applied to the wrapper.
